### How to use `scanf` to read 2 integers

<!--FIELD-->

```cpp
int a, b;
scanf("%d %d", &a, &b);
```

### How to use `cin`/`cout` to read external files

<!--FIELD-->

```cpp
freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
```
